svg.title: Himesh Gunathilake — Full Stack Engineer, exploring AI
svg.desc: A design-canvas style header: the name Himesh Gunathilake selected like a layer in a design tool over a slowly shifting aurora background, live cursors moving around it, and a glass properties panel listing role, stack, focus and what he is exploring.

g.text: I build products end to end — from the database to the pixel,
and I’m exploring what AI changes about how we build.
leading mobile delivery on Scolaris GO
building a native macOS system analyzer
mapping trail hazards with MapLibre + PostGIS
